_doc: Annotation sidecar for IDWriteFont (most-derived IDWriteFont3). Keyed by <Interface>.<slotKey> where slotKey is the generated enum member (version-suffixed for overloads). Only deviations from the emitter defaults are listed; scalar getters, object/struct-out methods, and JS names are inferred.

IDWriteFont.GetMetrics1.name: getMetrics1
IDWriteFont.GetMetrics1._why: richer metrics; DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1 now generated (derived struct)

IDWriteFont.GetPanose._why: DWRITE_PANOSE has an unnamed nested struct; no reader yet

IDWriteFont.HasCharacter._why: keep the simpler IDWriteFont3 HasCharacter (slot 22, direct BOOL) instead of the HRESULT+exists overload (slot 12)

IDWriteFont.CreateFontFace._why: keep the IDWriteFont3 CreateFontFace (slot 19) returning the most-derived face

IDWriteFont.CreateFontFace3._why: the out param is IDWriteFontFace3**, but our single most-derived face wrapper is IDWriteFontFace
